caption: The drawing shows the upper portion of a carved wooden object, depicted vertically and rendered in shades of brown, beige, and gray. The top right segment features a rounded, scroll-like carving with three prominent curving sections, each shaded with darker brown lines and patches. To the left of the scroll, a vertical rectangular area displays a geometric, diamond-patterned texture in alternating light and dark brown tones. Beneath this section are additional rectangular elements; one of them is decorated with small flower-like dots arranged in rows, and another has a vertically oriented leaf design with detailed lines and dots along its edges. On the far left, the drawing tapers off into a lighter, less defined surface showing subtle horizontal wood grain, with two small, dark parallelogram-like shapes and an oval groove above them. The background is plain off-white, and the artist's signature, "Grace Thomas Sayler," along with the date, is present in the lower right corner.
title: Harp
